name: RJSONIO
resume: toJSON, fromJSON, isValidJSON, asJSVars, basicJSONHandler, emptyNamedList, and the Strict and JSON_T constants match RJSONIO 2.0.5. json parses the tokens. readJSONStream stays untranslated because it reads an R connection. Checked readJSONStream. All exports translated.

functions.name: toJSON
functions.done: Serializes ordinary R values, including the formatC width and the fast integer path.

check.case: Integers, named lists, numbers with NA and Inf, a data frame, a matrix, a factor, pretty, hex, and an array.

proof.r:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(jsonlite))
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(RJSONIO))


one <- function() {
  TJ <- RJSONIO::toJSON
  parts <- c(
    TJ(1:10),
    TJ(c(a = 1L, b = 2L)),
    TJ(c(TRUE, FALSE, NA)),
    TJ(c("a", NA, "b\"c")),
    TJ(character()),
    TJ(NULL),
    suppressWarnings(TJ(c(1.5, 2, NA, Inf, -Inf))),
    TJ(list(a = 1L, b = list(c = "x"))),
    TJ(list()),
    TJ(emptyNamedList),
    TJ(data.frame(a = 1:2, b = c("x", "y"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)),
    TJ(data.frame(a = 1:2, b = c("x", "y"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE), byrow = TRUE),
    TJ(matrix(1:4, 2)),
    TJ(factor(c("a", "b", NA))),
    TJ(list(a = I(1L))),
    TJ(list(a = 1:2), pretty = TRUE),
    TJ(list(a = 1L), asIs = FALSE),
    TJ("a\nb\tc", .escapeEscapes = FALSE),
    TJ(as.hexmode(c(10, 255))),
    TJ(pi),
    TJ(list2env(list(a = 1L), parent = emptyenv())),
    TJ(array(1:8, c(2, 2, 2))),
    suppressWarnings(TJ(mean)),
    TJ(data.frame(a = 1, b = "z", stringsAsFactors = FALSE))
  )
  paste(parts, collapse = "\n---\n")
}


value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (step_i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[step_i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
cat(sprintf('{"value":%s,"median_ms":%.17g}\n', jsonlite::toJSON(value, auto_unbox = TRUE), median(elapsed) * 1000))
proof.python:
import json, math, os, statistics, tempfile, time, warnings
from rjsonio import *
from rjsonio.values import Matrix

def one():
    with warnings.catch_warnings():
        warnings.simplefilter("ignore")
        parts = [
            toJSON(Atomic("integer", list(range(1, 11)))),
            toJSON(Atomic("integer", [1, 2], ["a", "b"])),
            toJSON(Atomic("logical", [True, False, None])),
            toJSON(Atomic("character", ["a", None, 'b"c'])),
            toJSON(Atomic("character", [])),
            toJSON(None),
            toJSON(Atomic("numeric", [1.5, 2.0, None, math.inf, -math.inf])),
            toJSON(RList([Atomic("integer", [1]), RList([Atomic("character", ["x"])], ["c"])], ["a", "b"])),
            toJSON(RList([])),
            toJSON(emptyNamedList),
            toJSON(DataFrame({"a": Atomic("integer", [1, 2]), "b": Atomic("character", ["x", "y"])})),
            toJSON(DataFrame({"a": [1, 2], "b": ["x", "y"]}), byrow=True),
            toJSON(Matrix([1, 2, 3, 4], 2, 2, "integer")),
            toJSON(Factor(["a", "b", None])),
            toJSON(RList([AsIs(Atomic("integer", [1]))], ["a"])),
            toJSON(RList([Atomic("integer", [1, 2])], ["a"]), pretty=True),
            toJSON(RList([Atomic("integer", [1])], ["a"]), as_is=False),
            toJSON(Atomic("character", ["a\nb\tc"]), escape_escapes=False),
            toJSON(HexMode([10, 255])),
            toJSON(Atomic("numeric", [math.pi])),
            toJSON(Environment({"a": Atomic("integer", [1])})),
            toJSON(Array([1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8], (2, 2, 2), "integer")),
            toJSON(lambda: None),
            toJSON(DataFrame({"a": Atomic("numeric", [1.0]), "b": Atomic("character", ["z"])})),
        ]
    return "\n---\n".join(parts)


value = one()
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
print(json.dumps({"value": value, "median_ms": statistics.median(elapsed)}, ensure_ascii=False))

functions.name: isValidJSON
functions.done: Reports whether libjson accepts the text or the file.

check.case: Arrays, a trailing comma, a root scalar, an unquoted key, and a file.

proof.r:
.libPaths(c(path.expand("~/R/library"), .libPaths()))

one <- function() {
  path <- tempfile(fileext = ".json")
  writeLines("[1, 2]", path)
  flags <- c(
    isValidJSON("[1, 2, 3]", asText = TRUE),
    isValidJSON("[1,]", asText = TRUE),
    isValidJSON("{", asText = TRUE),
    isValidJSON("null", asText = TRUE),
    isValidJSON("{a:1}", asText = TRUE),
    isValidJSON("{\"a\":1,}", asText = TRUE),
    isValidJSON("{\"a\":1,\"b\":}", asText = TRUE),
    isValidJSON("[1, /*c*/ 2]", asText = TRUE),
    isValidJSON(path)
  )
  paste(ifelse(flags, "TRUE", "FALSE"), collapse = "\n")
}

elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (step_i in seq_len(20)) {

  one()
  elapsed[[step_i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}

proof.python:
import json, math, os, statistics, tempfile, time, warnings
from rjsonio import *
from rjsonio.values import Matrix

def one():
    fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".json")
    os.write(fd, b"[1, 2]\n")
    os.close(fd)
    flags = [
        isValidJSON("[1, 2, 3]", as_text=True),
        isValidJSON("[1,]", as_text=True),
        isValidJSON("{", as_text=True),
        isValidJSON("null", as_text=True),
        isValidJSON("{a:1}", as_text=True),
        isValidJSON('{"a":1,}', as_text=True),
        isValidJSON('{"a":1,"b":}', as_text=True),
        isValidJSON("[1, /*c*/ 2]", as_text=True),
        isValidJSON(path),
    ]
    return "\n".join("TRUE" if flag else "FALSE" for flag in flags)

elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):

    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
print(json.dumps({"value": value, "median_ms": statistics.median(elapsed)}, ensure_ascii=False))
